## Project Overview
This is a modern, interactive, and responsive data analyst portfolio website built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Main portfolio page with all sections
- `styles.css` - Complete styling for the portfolio
- `script.js` - Interactive features and animations
- `assets/` - Images and other assets (screenshots, project thumbnails)
- `README.md` - Project documentation

## Key Features
- Fully responsive design (mobile-first approach)
- Dark/Light mode toggle
- Smooth scrolling navigation
- Interactive project gallery
- Contact form
- Skills visualization
- Smooth animations and transitions

## Development Rules
- Use vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (no frameworks)
- Ensure mobile responsiveness at all breakpoints
- Modern, clean, and minimalist design
- Semantic HTML for accessibility
